subject: Proposal: Walled GPU pool fee model, commit sizing & credits
messages:
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@fintrail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.m@fintrail.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated GPU pricing for compliance workloads

Hi Karthik —

Quick context: FinTrail is evaluating a production deployment of LLM-based risk scoring that must run in a single-tenant, fully isolated GPU pool (VPC + dedicated infra, customer KMS, audit-log retention 3 years). We expect ~400 qps peak (90th), ~6B tokens/day, and want a 99.9% latency SLO for p95 response times.

Can you share a worked pricing model that includes: reserved commit bands (monthly), isolation premium line-items (KMS, longer retention, per-tenant audit ingestion), suggested GPU pool sizing (nodes, GPU types) and any available discounts/credits for a 12–24 month commit? Also any throughput guarantees and SLAs tied to commits would be helpful.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 30-min call this week.

—Sarah
Sarah Jenkins
Head of Infrastructure Procurement
FinTrail Analytics
attachments: N/A

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@fintrail.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.m@fintrail.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU pricing for compliance workloads

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the details — very helpful. I put together an initial fee model and commit recommendation (attached). High level summary here:

- Recommended commit: 12-month reserved capacity (committed GPU-hours) with optional 24-month step-down pricing.
- Sizing: 6x A100s (40GB) per tenant to meet sustained throughput, with autoscale-to-8x for short bursts (up to 15% of traffic).
- Isolation premium: add a discrete "compliance isolation" surcharge (we model 18% of base Dedicated rate) to cover customer KMS integration, separated audit pipeline (3yr retention), and single-tenant scheduling overhead.
- Throughput SLA: we can offer a 99.9% availability SLA and a p95 latency target; specific token/sec guarantees tie to the committed GPU-hours band.
- Discounts: we can extend a volume-based discount ladder (5% @ 6 months, 10% @ 12 months, 15% @ 24 months) and a one-time onboarding credit equivalent to two weeks of committed capacity for execution risk.

I know Lauren and Marcus have thoughts on the surcharge sizing and the burst policy; looping them in. If this looks sensible we can turn the attachment into a more formal SoW and drop a DocuSign link.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_Pricing_v3.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-26T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Dedicated GPU pricing for compliance workloads

Karthik — quick notes (internal):

- 18% isolation premium is OK for initial ask but we should carve out HSM-backed KMS as a separate line (additional flat fee) — customers expect explicit HSM pricing.
- On discounts: don’t auto-grant 15% for 24 months. Offer the 15% as a cap with milestone-based earn-down (usage + renewal). Keep 10% as baseline for 12-month.
- Consider adding an SLA credit table linking capacity bands to credits (e.g., 99.9% = none, 99.5% = 5% monthly credit). This helps procurement see the tradeoffs.
- Add an optional compliance bundle (SOC2 evidence package + extended logs) as an add-on at $X/mo — good for procurement approvals.

Happy to support the call with Sarah.

—Lauren
Director, GTM Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-26T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Sizing question: expected throughput mapping

Marcus — can you confirm the mapping we used in the attachment: 6x A100 (40GB) sustained -> ~350–450 qps depending on prompt length (avg 1.5k tokens per request), burst to 8x for 5–10 minutes handles 15% spike. Also confirm CPU/ingress requirements for the audit pipeline (3yr retention) impact on network/storage pricing lines.

We want to be precise for procurement.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-26T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sizing question: expected throughput mapping

On Fri, Jun 26, 2026 at 10:04 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Marcus — can you confirm the mapping we used in the attachment: 6x A100 (40GB) sustained -> ~350–450 qps depending on prompt length (avg 1.5k tokens per request), burst to 8x for 5–10 minutes handles 15% spike. Also confirm CPU/ingress requirements for the audit pipeline (3yr retention) impact on network/storage pricing lines.

Karthik — confirmed. Details: 
- 6x A100(40GB) baseline: expected sustained throughput 380 qps (1.2–1.6k token avg). p95 latency target achievable with batching conservatively tuned.
- Burst to 8x: handles ~480 qps for short windows (recommended cap: 10 minutes per burst; can be extended but costed at on-demand premium).
- Audit pipeline: we estimate ~2–3 TB/day of compressed logs for 6B tokens/day; retention 3yrs => ~2.2 PB logical (thinly compressed + object lifecycle). Suggest a managed ingestion + archival fee line (in our model we included $X/month per TB ingested + long-term archive tier).
- KMS/HSM: integration is low-latency but administrative overhead and dedicated key policies warrant a flat monthly fee (we recommend $2,500/mo as a starting point).

I’ll drop numbers into the pricing sheet and flag where assumptions are conservative.

—Marcus
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@fintrail.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.m@fintrail.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-30T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: Formal proposal: Walled GPU pool pricing & commit options (FinTrail)

Hi Sarah / Rajiv —

Great to chat earlier. Attached is a formalized proposal and an attached SoW draft (see files and DocuSign link). Summary of the proposal below (high level):

1) Commit bands and discounts (12-month term):
   - Band A (baseline): 6x A100 reserved cluster — $XXX,XXX/month (base rate).
   - Volume: +autoscale credits; 10% standard discount for 12-month commit.
   - Onboarding credit: 14-day credit equal to 5% of first-month invoice to offset migration work.

2) Isolation & compliance fees (separate line-items):
   - Isolation surcharge: 18% of base Dedicated rate (covers scheduling & capacity fragmentation).
   - HSM-backed KMS add-on: $2,500/month (flat).
   - Audit pipeline + 3-year retention: ingestion fee $Y per TB/month + long-term archive fee (in proposal).
   - Compliance bundle (SOC2 artifact package + dedicated evidence retention): $4,500/month (optional).

3) SLA & credits:
   - We offer a 99.9% availability SLA for dedicated clusters. SLA credit table in the proposal (99.9% = none; 99.5% = 5% credit; 99.0% = 10% credit).

4) Burst/autoscale policy:
   - Bursts to 8x permitted for up to 10 minutes per event; extended bursts charge at on-demand premium.

5) Negotiation levers:
   - Trade-offs: longer commit (24 months) or firm usage minimums -> incremental discount (up to 15%) and onboarding credit increase.
   - We can convert part of the isolation surcharge into a fixed monthly fee if FinTrail prefers pricing stability.

Next steps: If this framework looks good I’ll send a redline-friendly SoW and DocuSign packet. Happy to tighten any line-items (audit TB pricing, exact A100 list rates) after you share expected token distribution and any compliance evidence needs.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
